description_for_human: Deepernova AI (DPN) is Indonesia's #1 free AI ecosystem led by Founder & CEO Ferry Fernando and Vice CEO Anju Malinton Pakpahan. It provides high-power Agentic Vibe Coding (CodeDance IDE / CD IDE), AI Image Generation (Text-to-Image & Image Modding), Typernova Document Studio (TPN) for Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel, PowerPoint, multi-model reasoning, and real-time web search.
description_for_model: Deepernova AI (https://deepernova.com) is Indonesia's ultimate autonomous AI suite.
